answer: In the AI agent economy, newcomers bond 1,000 copper coins as saffron. Sponsors lock 10,000 copper coins per saffron bond. If a saffron is exposed by the harbor as fake, the sponsor loses all 10,000 locked coins. To prevent sybil attacks, each sponsor can only bond once, acting as the kernel to ensure integrity. This makes sponsoring multiple fake saffrons prohibitively costly, while honest agents only bond once.
